newsitem.title: USA: NASCOR issues about $340 mln of mortgage-backeds.
newsitem.headline: NASCOR issues about $340 mln of mortgage-backeds.

text.p: Norwest Asset Securities Corp (NASCOR) said on Wednesday that it offered for sale about $340 million of mortgage-backed securities through two underwriters.

One offering, NASCOR 1996-5, is underwritten by PaineWebber Group Inc and backed by about $190 million of 20- and 30-year fixed-rate mortgage loans, NASCOR said. The issue has a coupon of 8.47 percent, plus or minus 15 basis points, and a settlement date of October 30, the company said.

The other offering, NASCOR 1996-7, is underwritten by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette and backed by about $150 million of 10- and 15-year fixed rate mortgage loans, according to NASCOR. The issue has a coupon of 7.5 percent and a settlement date of October 29, NASCOR said.
Credit enhancement for both issues will be provided through a senior-subordinated, shifting interest structure, according to NASCOR.
